case_name: City of Davao v. Court of Appeals and GSIS
ordinance_no: Davao City Real Property Tax Assessment on GSIS
title: DAVAO CITY MUNICIPAL REAL PROPERTY TAX ASSESSMENT ON GSIS PROPERTIES
enacting_clause: BE IT ORDAINED BY THE SANGGUNIANG PANLUNGSOD OF DAVAO CITY, IN SESSION ASSEMBLED, THAT:

sections.text: This Measure establishes the Municipal Real Property Tax Assessment Mandate on Government-Owned Corporation Assets.

Notices of assessment and warrants of levy are hereby issued imposing municipal real property taxes upon GSIS properties located in Matina and Ulas, Davao City, for outstanding municipal tax liabilities pursuant to the withdrawal of GOCC tax exemptions.
The City Treasurer is instructed to pursue all administrative remedies under the Local Government Code to enforce tax delinquencies against taxable properties.
This Measure takes effect immediately upon passage.
